verdict.rationale: Gitea documents its own CI/CD (Gitea Actions) and an official action runner, plus Kubernetes AutoScaling Runners, which supports running pipelines on runners you operate. Nothing shows vendor-hosted runners: the managed offering is a hosted Gitea environment, not a runner service. Centralized visibility across runners is also not documented. missing for 10: platform-hosted runner option, documented centralized runner/pipeline visibility across fleets, runner registration/scoping docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of Actions runners.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run pipelines on platform-hosted runners or my own private runners with centralized visibility

citations.quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions.
We provide an official go-sdk, a CLI tool called tea and an action runner for Gitea Action.
